recipe.input: 128x128 RGB [0,1], ImageNet mean/std inside the graph
recipe.augmentation: p=0.85 resolution degrade to 36-80 px and back; affine rotation +-180 deg, translate 4%, scale 0.85-1.15 (fill = sheet grey 235); h+v flips; brightness 0.2, contrast 0.25, saturation 0.3, hue 0.02; gamma 0.8-1.25; p=0.3 gaussian noise sd<=0.02

split: spatial within each photo: fold 1 tests on beans with centre x in the right half of their photo, fold 2 on the left half; temperature fitted on a random 20% per-photo validation split of the TRAINING half
upper_bound_warning: Every class comes from a single J4ckDev photo, so train and test beans share the photo's camera, lighting and sheet. Held-out accuracy here is an UPPER BOUND on accuracy for new photos, new farms or Yemeni beans.

int8_quant.quantised_ops: Conv + Gemm only (QDQ, per-channel QInt8 weights, QUInt8 activations, MinMax calibration on training crops)
int8_quant.rule: smallest k in [0, 4, 8, 10, 12, 13, 16, 20, 26] with argmax agreement >= 0.99 vs fp32 on calibration crops

int8_quant.quantised_ops: Conv + Gemm only (QDQ, per-channel QInt8 weights, QUInt8 activations, MinMax calibration on training crops)
int8_quant.rule: smallest k in [0, 4, 8, 10, 12, 13, 16, 20, 26] with argmax agreement >= 0.99 vs fp32 on calibration crops

deploy_decision.rule: INT8 only if within 1.5 points of fp32 (mean of held-out folds)
deploy_decision.browser_parity_rule: INT8 also needs onnxruntime-web wasm vs Python max abs prob diff <= 0.01 (60 crops)

selective.on: pooled held-out halves, fold models, fp32 ONNX, calibrated
selective.rule: lowest max-prob threshold whose answered accuracy is >=90% and stays >=90% for every higher threshold answering >=30 beans

final.temperature_source: mean of the two fold temperatures (each fitted on its fold's validation split)
final.latency_machine: MacBook M5 Pro CPU, onnxruntime 1.30.0 CPUExecutionProvider, intra_op_num_threads=1 (NOT a phone)

int8_quant.quantised_ops: Conv + Gemm only (QDQ, per-channel QInt8 weights, QUInt8 activations, MinMax calibration on training crops)
int8_quant.rule: smallest k in [0, 4, 8, 10, 12, 13, 16, 20, 26] with argmax agreement >= 0.99 vs fp32 on calibration crops

labels_json.note: Farz per-bean classifier, fp32 ONNX. input 'image' float32 [N,3,128,128] RGB in [0,1] (crop contract of src/beans/beanfinder.py); output 'probs' [N,5] = softmax(logits/T), T=0.825 baked in. Abstain (yellow '?') when max prob < abstain_below. Threshold chosen on within-photo spatially held-out J4ckDev beans for >=90% answered accuracy - an UPPER BOUND, not field accuracy; on CBD photos from India the model calls most beans 'broken' (reports/beans_model.json cbd_ood). Trained on J4ckDev Green Coffee Beans (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); the model inherits NC-SA, prototype only.

shipped.latency_machine: MacBook M5 Pro CPU, onnxruntime 1.30.0 Python CPUExecutionProvider, 1 thread (NOT a phone, NOT wasm)

cbd_ood.dataset: CBD Coffee Bean Dataset, Mendeley Data 52877z55vr (2024), CC BY 4.0, https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/52877z55vr/1
cbd_ood.what_it_is: OOD sanity check only: India, light box, size grades, NO per-bean defect labels. Not an accuracy measurement.

photo_level_rule.rule: photo answered 'not sure' when > 15% of its beans are below abstain_below (PLAN s.5)
photo_level_rule.note: the CBD columns are OOD behaviour only; CBD has no defect labels

demo_trays.honesty: Deployed model saw these beans in training (in-sample). 'out_of_fold' uses, per bean, the fold model that never saw it.
